subject.title: fix(ci): run Mantis Codex proof on Node 24

question: Is source-level upstream action metadata enough for this private proof workflow, or should maintainers require an exact Mantis Telegram Desktop Proof rerun showing the Codex action under Node 24 before merge?
rationale: The contributor cannot run the secret-backed Mantis lane from a fork, and the PR's own Mantis workflow jobs were skipped, so only a maintainer can decide whether to accept metadata proof or require private-infra proof.

options.title: Require exact proof rerun
options.body: Dispatch or otherwise observe the modified workflow before merge and confirm the Codex action selects Node 24 and reaches OpenClaw setup.

options.title: Accept metadata proof
options.body: Merge based on the upstream action metadata and green workflow sanity, then monitor the next Mantis run for regressions.

options.title: Fold into broad action update
options.body: Close or defer this focused PR only if the broader action-update PR becomes proof-positive and safe to land first.

recommendation.title: Require exact proof rerun
recommendation.body: Dispatch or otherwise observe the modified workflow before merge and confirm the Codex action selects Node 24 and reaches OpenClaw setup.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied by blame/history to the current Mantis workflow and has the strongest available routing signal for private proof-infra decisions.
